text.body: pāṇḍava prahlādanāradaparāśarapuṇḍarīkavyāsāmbarīśaśukaśaunakabhīṣmadālbhyān| rukmāṅgadārjunavasiṣṭhavibhīṣaṇādīn puṇyānimānparamabhāgavatānsmarāmi||1|| lomaharṣaṇa dharmo vivirdhati yudhiṣṭhirakīrtanena pāpaṃ praṇaśyati vṛkodarakīrtanena| śatrurvinaśyati dhanañjayakīrtanena mādrīsutau kathayatāṃ na bhavanti rogāḥ||2|| brahmā ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāvarajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti| dhyānena tena hatakilbiṣa cetanāste mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na punaḥ pibanti||3|| yudhiṣṭhira meghaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsaṃ śrīvatsāṅkaṃ kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgam| puṇyopetaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ vande sarvalokaikanātham||4|| kuntī svakarmaphalanirdiṣṭāṃ yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ vrajāmyaham| tasyāṃ tasyāṃ hṛṣīkeśa tvayi bhaktidṛrḍhā'stu me||5|| drupada kīṭeṣu pakṣiṣu mṛgeṣu sarīsṛpeṣu rakṣaḥpiśācamanujeṣvapi yatra yatra| jātasya me bhavatu keśava tvatprasādāt tvayyeva bhaktiracalā'vyabhicāriṇī me||6|| abhimanyu govinda govinda hare murāre govinda govinda rathāṅgapāṇe| govinda govinda mukunda kṛṣṇa govinda govinda namo namaste||7|| uddhava vāsudevaṃ parityajya yo'nyaṃ devamupāsate| tṛṣito jāhnavītīre kūpaṃ vāñchati durbhagaḥ||8|| vidura vāsudevasya ye bhaktāḥ śāntāstadgatamānasāḥ| teṣāṃ dāsasya dāso'haṃ bhave janmani janmani||9|| bhīṣma viparīteṣu kāleṣu parikṣīṇeṣu bandhuṣu| trāhi māṃ kṛpayā kṛṣṇa śaraṇāgatavatsala||10|| droṇa ye ye hatāścakradhareṇa rājaṃ strailokyanāthana janārdanena| te te gatā viṣṇupuriṃ prayātāḥ krodho'pi devasya vareṇa tulyaḥ||11|| gāndhārī tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva tvameva bandhuśca sakhā tvameva| tvameva vidyā draviṇaṃ tvameva tvameva sarvaṃ mama deva deva||12|| prahlāda nātha yonisahasreṣu yeṣu yeṣu vrajāmyaham| teṣu teṣvacalā bhaktiracyuta'su sadā tvayi||13|| yā prītiravivekanāṃ viṣayeṣvanapāyini| tvāmanusmarataḥ sā me hṛdayānmā'pasarpatu||14|| bhāradvāja lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ kutasteṣāṃ parājayaḥ| yeṣāmindīśvaraśyāmo hṛdayastho janārdanaḥ||15|| atri govindeti sadā snānaṃ govindeti sadā japaḥ| govindeti sadā dhyānaṃ sadā govindakīrtanam||16|| āvirhotra kṛṣṇa tvadīyapadapaṅkajapañjarānte adyaiva me viśatu mānasarājahaṃsaḥ| prāṇaprayāṇasamaye kaphavātapitāiḥ kaṇṭhāvarodhanavidhau smaraṇaṃ kutaste||17|| vidura hararnāmaiva nāmaiva nāmāmaiva mama jīvanam| kalau nāsyeva nāsteva nāstyeva gatiranyathā||18|| vaśiṣṭha kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravartate| bhasmībhavantu tasyāśu mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ||19|| duryodhana jānāmi dharmaṃ na ca me pravṛttirjānāmyadharmaṃ na ca me nivṛttiḥ| kenāpi devena hṛdisthitena yathā niyukto'smi tathā karomi||20|| subhadra eko'pi kṛṣṇasya kṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ| daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya||21|| garga nārāyaṇeti mantro'sti vāgasti vaśavartini| tathāpi narake ghore patantītyetadadbhutam||22|| parāśara sakṛduccaritaṃ yena harirityakṣaradvayam| baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati||23|| vyāsa satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ bhujamutthāpya cocyate| na vedācca paraṃ śāstraṃ na devaḥ keśavātparaḥ||24|| dhanvantari acyutānanta govinda nāmoccāraṇabheṣajāt| naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham||25|| mārkaṇḍeya sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sā cāndhajaḍamūḍhatā| yanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi vāsudevaṃ na cintayet||26|| śrīśuka āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicāryaivaṃ punaḥ punaḥ| idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā||27|| śrīmahādeva śarīra ca navacchidraṃ vyādhigrastaṃ kalevaram auṣadhaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ vaidyo nārāyaṇo hariḥ||28|| śaunaka bhojanācchādane cintāṃ vṛthā kurvanti vaiṣṇavāḥ| yo'sau viśvambharo devaḥ sa bhaktānkimupekṣate||29|| ākāśātpatitaṃ toyaṃ yathā gacchati sāgaram| sarvadevanamaskāraḥ keśavaṃ prati gacchati||30||
